brief: A low leather concertina bellows compressed between two fitted wooden boards, angled brass nozzle pointing right into empty space. One large open handle and visible hinge, warm matte leather, selective copper.
A long thick stone quench trough with a dark steel bar resting across the rim, one broad cool reflective water plane and a restrained curl of steam. Horizontal silhouette, visibly supported weight.

A single weathered iron anvil on a low square masonry block. One long tapered horn pointing left, heavy square heel right; broad steel planes with restrained copper reflected light, no weapon or sword.
A compact workbench with a broad iron vise attached visibly to one corner, open jaws facing left and a diagonal wooden brace under the slab. Three-quarter composition with no loose tool clutter.
A tilted thick ceramic crucible held in a fitted iron fork above a low stone stand. A small orange warm interior plane, no molten splash, support bars visibly meet the load.

An asymmetrical wedge-shaped iron coal hopper on two short fitted feet, one hinged feed door open below. One connected dark coal mass in the upper mouth; selective warm ember accent in a quiet recess.
A freestanding three-tier broad iron cooling rack bearing two uneven ceramic molds and one blank ingot. Open shelf gaps and diagonal rear brace, subdued metal planes, no weapons or relics.
A short masonry forge vent with a bent dark iron hood and an offset flue; a warm slit recessed below the hood. Strong elbow-shaped contour, a fitted lower foot, no giant smokestack or busy smoke.
